# CycloneDX 1.6 validation schemas

Unmodified upstream files retrieved 2026-10-21 from the CycloneDX specification `1.6` tag:
https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/tree/1.6/schema

Apache-2.0 license is preserved in LICENSE. These are build-time validation data, not runtime dependencies. Updates must replace the upstream files and review their hashes. Ajv validates structure and constraints offline; format annotations are disabled (no external format resolver). The generator constructs package URLs and hashes from local evidence.
